title: Nutella Delight
description: A rich dessert made with Nutella and earthy undertones.

ingredients.name: One pot
ingredients.amount: 1 (note: this is an unconventional ingredient, treat as a placeholder)

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Nutella, earthy delight, sugar, and flour. Mix until well combined.
Add in butter and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Roll out dough to 1/4 inch thickness and cut into desired shapes.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until edges are lightly golden.
Allow cookies to cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
